title: Playing the University of Miami homecoming, a first for a Black band
summary: Burns persuades Miami students to fly the band in for homecoming; Fields shows a photo with Dr. Thurston Adams.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: We made this round on and on and I will say that I have a write up there that Burns is responsible for and we'll send that in to Ron too, The University of Miami. You see, by Burns booking the Wings over (inaudible), he just knew when they'd be in the south or when they'd be in the north and so he had got together with some youngsters at the University of Miami and they, I think, had said to him, well

So Burns said you can't miss this opportunity to get a terrific man like this, to play that homecoming, and he decided some kind of way that he would--Burns even told him where we would be--at that time I don't think he knew where we would be, I think he told him some kind of lie to where we'd be and it would be so far they'd have to fly us in, they'd have to pay more money to fly us in, and he got that extra money and we got that homecoming dance; there's a picture of me and student director and I have also a write up--Dr. Thurston Adams.
Yeah, you're shaking hands with him.
youngsters presented me with the check that night for flying the band in.
Yeah, yeah, it's a write up in the paper there.
